notes.account: The continuation proposes studying sheaves, complexes or fields/champs that are constructible for a fixed partition P, or locally constant on its strata. It asks for stability under the displayed usual operations. It states a conditional known stability claim for constructible torsion sheaves with residue-characteristic restrictions under excellence and resolution of singularities, while distinguishing a fixed partition from refinements. It then anticipates arbitrarily fine stratifications with equisingularity properties and begins an example at the bottom. These are the author’s assertions, not results independently proved in this reading.
